# Recommended Vancomycin Doses based on patient weight:
Weight less than 70 kg:
Vancomycin 1000 mg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision
Weight equal/greater 70 kg and equal/less than 100 kg:
Vancomycin 1500 mg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision
Weight greater than 100 kg:
Vancomycin 2000 mg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG VANCOMYCIN WEIGHT BASED DOSING
Outpt: ORZID2 GMENU SURG VANCOMYCIN WEIGHT BASED DOSING
